hero.title: We build audiences that last.
hero.lead: ARNOVA designs, grows and operates its own websites. We combine editorial craft, search optimisation and monetisation to turn an audience into a durable asset.

services.title: What we do
services.lead: Three disciplines, one logic: growing websites we run as long-term assets.

marketing.title: Digital marketing
marketing.body: Acquisition, organic search, audience analytics: we drive growth end to end, from the keyword to the conversion.

publishing.title: Web publishing
publishing.body: We own and edit our own websites. Every project is run like a brand: editorial line, identity, reading quality.

monetization.title: Monetisation
monetization.body: Affiliate, advertising, partnerships: we build revenue models that are legible and matched to each audience.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.lead: Three principles that guide our calls, from the editorial line to acquisition.

content.title: Content before traffic
content.body: A genuinely useful page defends itself, and keeps doing so. We write for readers, not for an algorithm.

data.title: Decide on evidence
data.body: Every editorial call rests on measurement: real queries, reading behaviour, revenue per page.

longTerm.title: The long game
longTerm.body: We grow our websites to keep them. Our decisions are judged over years, not over a quarter.

company.title: The company

cta.title: A website, a project, an idea?
cta.body: We look at acquisition, partnership and ad-sales opportunities. Write to us — we answer quickly.

Contact.lead: A question, a partnership proposal, a website to sell? Write to us: the form lands straight in our inbox.

Legal.title: Legal notice
Legal.lead: Legal information about arnova.fr, published in accordance with French Act No. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004 on confidence in the digital economy.

hosting.title: Hosting and delivery
hosting.cdn: Pages are delivered by Vercel’s edge network, which acts as a content delivery network (CDN): each page is served from the point of presence closest to the visitor.
hosting.dns: The domain name is managed at <link>{name}</link> in DNS-only mode: Cloudflare points visitors to Vercel’s servers but does not relay the site’s traffic or access its content.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: Every element making up this site — text, images, logos, trade marks, structure and code — is protected by copyright and trade mark law. Any reproduction, representation, adaptation or exploitation, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of {company}, is prohibited.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: {company} strives to keep the information published on this site accurate and up to date, without being able to guarantee that it is exhaustive. The site may link to third-party sites whose content is not the responsibility of {company}.

data.title: Personal data and cookies
data.body: How personal data collected on this site is handled is described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>, and the only cookie it sets on the <cookies>Cookies page</cookies>.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: This site collects very little personal data. This page sets out, processing by processing, what is collected, why, who receives it, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: The data controller is {company}, a French {legalForm} whose registered office is at {address}. For any question about your data, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

contactForm.title: Contact form and email
contactForm.intro: When you write to us through the contact form, your message is sent straight from your browser to the form-delivery service, which forwards it to us by email. If you write to {email} instead, your email is received by our domain’s mail provider, which redirects it to the same inbox.
contactForm.data: Your name, your email address and the content of your message, plus your browser’s IP address, which the form-delivery service receives when you submit.
contactForm.purpose: Answering your request and following up on our exchanges.
contactForm.legalBasis: ARNOVA’s legitimate interest in answering people who contact it (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)) and, when your request concerns a project or a partnership, steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b)).
contactForm.recipients: {form}, a service run by {operator} ({country}), which receives the form and forwards it by email; to filter abuse, it may submit your IP address and email address to anti-spam services. {relay} ({relayOperator}, {relayCountry}), which receives the emails sent to {email} and redirects them to ARNOVA’s inbox without keeping a copy. {mailProvider} ({mailService}), which hosts that inbox.
contactForm.retention: Three years from our last exchange, then deleted. For its part, {form} states in its <link>privacy policy</link> that it keeps submissions for at most three years.

hostingLogs.title: Hosting logs ({host})
hostingLogs.intro: Like any web server, the {host} infrastructure automatically records technical logs for every request it receives, whether or not you use the form.
hostingLogs.data: IP address, date and time, requested page, browser (user agent) and response code of each request.
hostingLogs.purpose: Running the site, protecting it against abuse and diagnosing errors.
hostingLogs.legalBasis: ARNOVA’s legitimate interest in keeping the site available and secure (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)).
hostingLogs.recipients: {host}, the site’s hosting provider, acting as a processor.
hostingLogs.retention: A short period set by {host}, after which the logs are deleted automatically (see the <link>{host} privacy policy</link>).

transfers.title: Transfers outside the European Union
transfers.host: {host} is a company established in the United States. Transfers of data to this hosting provider are covered by the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework, to which it is certified, and by the standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission.
transfers.form: {form} is run by {operator}, a company established outside the European Union ({country}), on infrastructure hosted in the United States among other places. Its transfers rely on the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses, set out in its data processing agreement.
transfers.mail: Emails sent to {email} are received by {relay} on servers located in the European Union ({relayCountry}). ARNOVA’s inbox, however, is a consumer {mailService} account: it is provided in the European Economic Area by {mailOperator} ({mailCountry}) under {mailProvider}’s terms of service and <link>privacy policy</link>, not under a data processing agreement. {mailProvider} may store messages in data centres outside the European Union, including in the United States, and states that it covers these transfers with the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework and the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

noSale.title: {company} does not sell your data
noSale.body: {company} does not sell, rent or hand over your personal data. It is never used for direct marketing, profiling or targeted advertising.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights over your data:

items.access: Access: confirmation that data about you is processed, and a copy of it.
items.rectification: Rectification: having inaccurate data corrected or incomplete data completed.
items.erasure: Erasure: having your data deleted, in particular once it is no longer needed.
items.restriction: Restriction: having the use of your data temporarily frozen, for instance while its accuracy is checked.
items.objection: Objection: objecting to processing based on legitimate interest, on grounds relating to your particular situation.
items.portability: Portability: receiving the data you provided in a structured, machine-readable format, or having it sent to another controller.
items.postMortem: Post-mortem instructions: deciding what happens to your data after your death (Article 85 of the French Data Protection Act).
items.withdrawal: Withdrawal of consent: where processing relies on your consent, withdrawing it at any time, without affecting processing already carried out.

rights.exercise: To exercise these rights, write to <mail>{email}</mail>. We answer within one month, which may be extended by two months for complex requests; if we have reasonable doubts about your identity, we may ask you to confirm it.

complaint.title: Complaint to the CNIL
complaint.body: If, after contacting us, you believe your rights have not been respected, you may lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority: <link>www.cnil.fr/fr/plaintes</link>.

security.title: Security and data breaches
security.measures: The site is served over HTTPS only, and the form is sent encrypted to the form-delivery service. Access to the inbox is restricted to ARNOVA.
security.breach: In the event of a personal data breach, {company} notifies the CNIL within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, unless it is unlikely to result in a risk to your rights (GDPR Article 33), and informs you directly if that risk is high (Article 34).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The site sets a single technical cookie, which remembers your display language, and no audience-measurement or advertising tracker. The details are on the <link>Cookies page</link>.

Cookies.title: Cookies
Cookies.lead: arnova.fr sets a single cookie, strictly necessary to show the site in your language. That is why no banner asks for your consent.

list.title: Cookie set
list.intro: This is the complete list of cookies the site may set in your browser.
list.caption: Cookies set by arnova.fr
list.exemption: This cookie is strictly necessary to provide the service you ask for, so it is exempt from prior consent under Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act and the CNIL guidelines.

locale.purpose: Remembering your display language (French or English) so that the right version of each page is served on later visits.
locale.lifetime: Session: deleted when the browser closes

none.title: No trackers
none.analytics: No audience measurement: no Google Analytics or similar tool.
none.ads: No advertising and no advertising cookies.
none.thirdParty: No third-party trackers: no social media buttons, embedded videos or tracking pixels.
none.fonts: Fonts are served by the site itself: your browser does not contact any third-party font service.
none.consequence: The site therefore uses no cookie or tracker that would require your consent.

manage.title: Managing cookies
manage.body: You can delete this cookie or block cookies at any time in your browser settings. The site remains fully usable: the language will simply be worked out again from the page address or your browser preferences.
manage.privacy: For the other data processed during your visit, including hosting logs, see the <link>privacy policy</link>.
